summary: Phase-31 token/advance double-counting fix — backend math verified. All 7 mandated scenarios pass (POST COD with token/no-token/token>amount, POST Prepaid, PUT amount recompute, CSV COD Balance column, smart-paste→ship). Regression test (omit cod_amount from payload) also passes — no KeyError/NaN. 8/9 tests green. The 9th test is an extra edge-case I added that exposes a partial-update bug in PUT /api/shipments/{id}: when the client PUTs only `amount` (without re-sending payment_mode) on an existing COD shipment, cod_amount silently flips to 0.0 instead of recomputing as max(0, new_amount − token).

minor.issue: Partial-update with only `amount` (no payment_mode in payload) collapses cod_amount to 0 on existing COD shipments. routers/shipments_write.py:373-376 reads `update.get('payment_mode', '')` only — should fall back to the existing doc's payment_mode. The mandated PATCH scenario in the request passes because the test sends payment_mode='COD' alongside amount; real frontend edit-amount-only call will hit this bug.

action_items: Fix routers/shipments_write.py:357-377 — when 'amount' is in update but 'payment_mode' is NOT, read the existing shipment's payment_mode (already fetched once at line 334 in the terminal-state check, can be returned in the projection) and use it to decide the COD math branch. Otherwise PUT {amount: X} on a COD row will zero out cod_amount.

Note: the original problem statement mentions PATCH /api/shipments/{id} but the server only exposes PUT (routers/shipments_write.py:317). If a PATCH endpoint is intended, it needs to be added; otherwise update the spec/frontend to use PUT.
Optional: also project payment_mode + token_amount in the same single find_one() call at the top of update_shipment to avoid two round-trips when the amount path is taken.
critical_code_review_comments: Canonical math is correctly applied in 3 places — POST (routers/shipments_write.py:179-187), ship-from-pending (lines 728-740), PUT (lines 357-377) — but the PUT branch only honors payment_mode coming through the update payload, not the existing row. This is a latent partial-update bug.
CSV export logic in routers/shipments_read.py:222-232 correctly prefers stored cod_amount over recomputing amount−token. Verified with row Amount=1000.00 Token=200.00 COD Balance=800.00.

Smart-paste regex parser correctly extracts 'Token: 150' via server.py:2102-2103 (TOKEN/TOKEN_AMOUNT/ADVANCE mappings). Pending order persists token_amount=150 → ship endpoint computes cod_amount=450 as expected.
Negative-clamp guard `max(0.0, _amount - _token)` confirmed for the amount=300/token=400 case → cod_amount=0 (not −100).

success_rate.backend: 100% on mandated scenarios (8/8 required) — 89% overall (8/9 including extra edge-case)

seed_data_creation: Created ~8 TEST_P31MATH_* shipments (COD/Prepaid mix) plus 1 TEST_P31MATH_PASTE_* pending order promoted to a shipment in user2@test.com's workspace. Each is uniquely tagged with a TESTM<uuid> tracking id for easy cleanup. Master sheet rows were also written as side-effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-31 canonical math (amount stored verbatim; cod_amount=max(0, amount-token)) is fully verified for POST /api/shipments, PUT /api/shipments/{id} (when payload includes payment_mode), POST /api/smart-paste→POST /api/orders/pending/{id}/ship, and the CSV export's 'COD Balance' column. Known latent bug: PUT with only `amount` zeros cod_amount on existing COD rows — see action_items.
rca_of_issue: PUT /api/shipments/{id} update path at routers/shipments_write.py:373-376 evaluates `update.get('payment_mode', '') == 'COD'`. When the frontend issues a partial update containing only amount (the common 'edit just the amount' flow), payment_mode is absent from the payload, the ternary takes the else branch, and cod_amount is set to 0.0 — wiping the leftover balance for COD orders. Mitigation: also consult the previously-loaded `existing` doc (already fetched at line 334) for payment_mode when the update payload omits it.
